rapport_notes: Amy is professional and clear but lacks warmth; the call feels transactional rather than consultative.
process_discipline_notes: No explicit violations of repetition or silence-holding rules, though silence management is minimal throughout.

evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Let me start with a few questions to get it on the right track. This call will probably take about ten minutes or so and then I'll be able to give you an accurate quote that you can depend on.
evidence_quotes.agenda_missing: Rep never asks 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move, and what do you want answers to on this call?'
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep_missing: Customer says 'I just need help with the heavy stuff' and 'I don't want them broke' (dishes) — Amy acknowledges but pivots to logistics without follow-up questions like 'tell me more about that' or 'what else is on your mind?'
evidence_quotes.sheet1_careful_with_missing: No mention of damage coverage, careful handling, or the '$2,000 we move it like it's ours' framing.
evidence_quotes.sheet2_whos_coming_missing: No mention of Meet Your Mover, named crew lead, or who will show up.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_missing: Not covered anywhere in the call.
evidence_quotes.communication_missing: Not covered anywhere in the call.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor_partial: Amy gives a range for boxes only ('15 to 25 boxes') but does not anchor a typical time estimate for the move itself or personalize the duration to the customer's situation (upstairs to downstairs, two lazy-boy chairs, boxes).
evidence_quotes.beats_it_pay_less: We will prorate the time and every fifteen minute increments.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass_frame_missing: The estimate is not framed as a 'window because your move is yours' with specific factors; no commitment language; no self-prep tip; no 'does that feel fair?' with silence.
evidence_quotes.close_missing: Amy says 'If you're ready to book we don't require any deposits or if you have any questions just give us a call back' — no rate-lock mention and no explicit 'would you like our help?' ask; the call ends abruptly.

top_strength: Amy established a clear quid pro quo and successfully gathered logistics details; she confirmed the customer's inventory and provided a specific pricing range ($545–$654) with a 2.5-hour minimum, all delivered clearly.
coaching_note: Amy must ask the customer's agenda before diving into logistics — 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?' — then dig two layers deep on any concern raised (damage, timing, crew quality); she also skipped all four differentiators (damage coverage, Meet Your Mover, On-Time Guarantee, Communication) and did not close with a rate-lock + explicit ask.
